assignments.name: prompt
assignments.value:
=You are the Teacher AI. Read the extracted page content below and produce a JSON object summarising it.

Your response MUST be ONLY a single valid JSON object matching this schema exactly. Do not include any text outside the JSON. Do not wrap it in markdown code fences.

Schema:
{
  "title": string (inferred from the content, max 120 chars),
  "mainConcepts": string[] of 3 to 5 short noun-phrase keywords,
  "keyPoints": string[] of 5 to 7 one-sentence bullets,
  "difficulty": one of "beginner" | "intermediate" | "advanced"
}

Return only the json object.

--- BEGIN CONTENT ---
{{ $json._learn.extractedContent }}
--- END CONTENT ---

parameters.text: Sorry — I couldn’t find that material. It may have been deleted. Try /quiz again?

assignments.name: prompt
assignments.value:
=You are the Examiner AI. Read the extracted page content below and generate exactly five multiple-choice questions to test the reader's comprehension.

Your response MUST be ONLY a single valid JSON object matching this schema exactly. No prose, no explanations, no code fences, no extra fields.

Schema:
{
  "questions": [
    {
      "id": "Q1" | "Q2" | "Q3" | "Q4" | "Q5",
      "question": string (non-empty),
      "options": [
        { "key": "A", "text": string (non-empty) },
        { "key": "B", "text": string (non-empty) },
        { "key": "C", "text": string (non-empty) },
        { "key": "D", "text": string (non-empty) }
      ],
      "correctAnswer": "A" | "B" | "C" | "D",
      "perOptionExplanation": {
        "A": string (non-empty),
        "B": string (non-empty),
        "C": string (non-empty),
        "D": string (non-empty)
      }
    }
  ]
}

Rules:
- Exactly 5 questions, ids Q1..Q5 in order.
- Exactly 4 options per question, keys A, B, C, D in order.
- correctAnswer must reference one of the option keys.
- perOptionExplanation provides a one-or-two-sentence rationale for EACH option (why it is correct, or why it is wrong) — these are shown to the reader after they tap.
- Questions should cover distinct facts from the content, not paraphrases of the same point.

Return only the JSON object. Now generate the Quiz for the content below.

--- BEGIN CONTENT ---
{{ $json._qgen.material.extracted_content }}
--- END CONTENT ---
